study_family_note: B-SNIP companion analyses were consolidated to a shared family root for independence auditing. Reviews/meta-analyses can overlap primary cohorts and do not become independent biological replications merely by being separate publications.
search_provenance_status: Early-cycle search strings are normalized/reconstructed from session records after context compaction; later cycle strings are exact. Do not interpret 70 as an exact reproducible database screening count.
telemetry_note: Unavailable token/cost/wall-time values were not invented.
saturation_scope: Primary subtype/ontology classification within web-accessible evidence; not exhaustive history or systematic database coverage.
